That ghost story reminded me of the importance of standing up to fear and facing challenges head-on. This is particularly relevant today, as we confront the rising threat of a new type of extremism and terrorism. Enemies like the ones who carried out attacks in places like New York, Washington D.C., Bali, London, Madrid, Moscow, and many other places cannot be appeased through ignorance or disengagement. With the growing lethality and availability of weapons, we cannot afford to ignore the dangers of vicious extremism. Some people seem to have forgotten the lessons of history, but we must not make the same mistake. We cannot ignore the threat of extremism and hope that it will go away on its own.
